comment: C-first source freeze before recording or JavaScript comparison. Move east off the observed upstairs, use the exact trapname from defsym.h to wish a squeaky board with objnam.c:wizterrainwish, create a sleeping goblin through cmd.c -> wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis -> read.c:create_particular, then leave the board square west onto the upstairs and return east to trigger it. C must establish successful trap creation, goblin position/sleep state, hero dotrap -> trapeffect_sqky_board, and any wake_nearby(FALSE) state change. Keep a failed creation, misplaced monster, or missed trigger as an actual C target miss; do not infer wake behavior from the recipe.
